# environmental data
## extracting the data
```{r}
points <- data.frame(
  lon = c(-118.255386, -118.687127),
  lat = c(37.634902, 37.223629),
  site = c("White Mountains", "Piute Pass")
)

# Convert to spatial object and project
sites <- vect(points, geom = c("lon", "lat"), crs = "EPSG:4326")
sites <- project(sites, merged)

# Make individual 1-km buffers per site
buffers <- buffer(sites, width = 1000)

# Helper function to extract means for each variable set
extract_means <- function(file_list, sites_buffer, var_name) {
  allrasters <- lapply(file_list, rast)
  
  map_dfr(1:length(allrasters), function(i) {
    extracted <- terra::extract(allrasters[[i]], sites_buffer, xy = TRUE)
    
    val_col <- names(extracted)[2]
    
    extracted %>%
      group_by(ID) %>%
      summarise(mean_value = mean(.data[[val_col]], na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
      mutate(
        raster = i,
        site = points$site[ID],
        variable = var_name
      )
  })
}
```

```{r}
Tave_file_list <- c("analysis/environment/Normal_1991_2020/Normal_1991_2020_monthly/Normal_1991_2020_Tave06.tif", "analysis/environment/Normal_1991_2020/Normal_1991_2020_monthly/Normal_1991_2020_Tave07.tif", "analysis/environment/Normal_1991_2020/Normal_1991_2020_monthly/Normal_1991_2020_Tave08.tif")
Tmax_file_list <- c("analysis/environment/Normal_1991_2020/Normal_1991_2020_monthly/Normal_1991_2020_Tmax06.tif", "analysis/environment/Normal_1991_2020/Normal_1991_2020_monthly/Normal_1991_2020_Tmax07.tif", "analysis/environment/Normal_1991_2020/Normal_1991_2020_monthly/Normal_1991_2020_Tmax08.tif")
Tmin_file_list <- c("analysis/environment/Normal_1991_2020/Normal_1991_2020_monthly/Normal_1991_2020_Tmin06.tif", "analysis/environment/Normal_1991_2020/Normal_1991_2020_monthly/Normal_1991_2020_Tmin07.tif", "analysis/environment/Normal_1991_2020/Normal_1991_2020_monthly/Normal_1991_2020_Tmin08.tif")

Tave_results <- extract_means(Tave_file_list, buffers, "Tave")
Tmax_results <- extract_means(Tmax_file_list, buffers, "Tmax")
Tmin_results <- extract_means(Tmin_file_list, buffers, "Tmin")

env.results <- rbind(Tave_results, Tmax_results, Tmin_results)
```
## all together now...

```{r}
library(dplyr)

summary_df <- env.results %>%
  group_by(variable, site) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_overall = mean(mean_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_overall   = sd(mean_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_value    = min(mean_value),
    max_value    = max(mean_value)
  )
summary_df

write.csv(summary_df, "br_enviro.csv")
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(env.results, aes(x = raster, y = mean_value,
                        color = variable,
                        group = interaction(variable, site),
                        linetype = site)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:3, labels = c("Jun", "Jul", "Aug")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Piute Pass" = "solid", "White Mountains" = "dashed")) +
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = "Mean value",
    title = "Monthly Climate Averages",
    color = "Variable",
    linetype = "Site"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

```
